Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.resources

Class ResourceManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.resources.ResourceManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResourceStateMutator, ResourceStateView
public class ResourceManager extends Object implements ResourceStateMutator
Tracks resource amounts and applies resource transactions.
